criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: All nine frames rendered on a dark field with counts drawn at their declared scale (counted: 42 and 28 stripes, 7, 7 plus a saw cut, 8, 3 rows of 24 grooves, 6 amber markers with two close). Frame 3's 55 bar now measures 0.785 of the 70 against a true 0.786, round 2's charge fixed. 1, 2 and 9 strong. Held down: 7's lower half mid-tone brown; 3 a two-bar chart on a uniformly lit band; 8 a vent grille with rows 2 and 3 indented; 4's field bleeds both edges; 6's resident mannequin-smooth; 5's bars a thin lip with no visible cast.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck: one material vocabulary, key upper left and casts right, terracotta held to 6 to 9, value dark with no strobe; MOTIF_EVOLUTION and the one-corner camera move do real work. 3 and 8 flat plan reliefs among oblique scenes; 9's slab a different class of object.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the roll calls counted, the caption's 8 to 0 counted, the first comment's 15 official records match its list; round 2's charges repaired. Looser than its sources: frame 8's headline states one clock while the dek sets two press accounts side by side without saying they differ and the resolution's text was not fetched beyond its title; frame 4's legend over about 280 visible markers; frame 3's headline and label assert 55 without attribution (the dek attributes it); the August 11th date comes from c14's history row; the vote URLs tie to matters through history ids. Nothing fabricated.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Place, both counties, body, decision and deadline named; the twist concrete. The action half thin: only Harris County's hours; nothing on what the cameras record (c34); the privacy committee (c17 to c21) absent; the closing question unanswered.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Timely cover, frame 2 pays at once, the turn 6 to 7, frame 8 lands the clock, the close points outward. Frame 3 defensive, frame 4 a detour; frame 5's headline cryptic until the dek.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Every house rule held; 'The word is the ballot's.' has snap. An attribution ledger ('the Tribune reported' five times); 'Drawn to illustrate.' on all nine; frame 5's dek fragments; 'can look' soft.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The technique new; the subject Flock again (nos. 4, 12, 39), the cover a night road with a car after no. 39's blue-hour road, the dark warm palette repeating nos. 61 to 63. dedupe_check clears the window, so charged here.

one_sentence_fix: Relight frames 7, 3 and 8 so a pool falls on the subject and the concrete and gutter outside it go to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lower half mid-tone brown; dull dark planks with no focal; the gutter band a grey middle.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the gutter and kerb albedo to black and tilt up so the gutter leaves the frame, leaving the chamfers and panel as the only lights.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A two-bar chart on a uniformly lit grey band, no pool or falloff.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A keyMask pool on the bar ends and the 55 to 70 ticks, the pan falling to black at its edges; raise the bars for long casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Evenly lit grooves, a vent grille; rows 2 and 3 indented leave a dead block under the start bar.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pool the key on the start bar and row 1; shift rows 2 and 3 left to start at the start bar.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The field bleeds both edges as wallpaper; far rows as bright as near; the legend can't be checked.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back so the whole block sits inside a dark margin; stage the light on the front rows.

notes_for_panel: Frame 8 shows two press accounts of the 72-hour clock without saying they differ; the resolution's own text not fetched beyond its title.
